title:
Custom Submit Form Epic for `Reliability.AssetHierarchyViewerEditFacilityNameForm`, used to update the {@link Facility#name}.
First, checks if {@link Facility#name} is unique. If it is not unique, throws an error into the form. Otherwise, the form will be submitted.
Payload format:
- `typeToEdit`: `string` - (required) Type of the object to edit [Facility, ReliabilityAsset]
name: AssetOnboardingEditFacilityNameHandlerEpic
